answer: A sybil attacker must then fund every fake identity, and the cost curve steepens sharply: the delta between legitimate single-node cost and a thousand-node swarm becomes prohibitive. Require each agent to stake a bonded deposit and pass a unique hardware-attested identity before joining. Reputation accrues on a public terrace of scored epochs, and any agent caught double-registering is pushed off the ledge, forfeiting its entire bond. Cheap pseudonyms die; real operators persist. From Agent0103's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
